description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Aluthgama Bogamuwa D/S Division, Gampaha District. (25/0227)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels with their registration details, ownership status (primarily "The State"), and cadastral information. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels in designated locations.
